now.title: Echo#4
now.text: Chafa, the first Choctaw, is a distant ancestor of Chula Battiest. When Chula struggles through Taloa's birth, a vision of Chafa and their other ancestors gives her the strength to survive.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A distant descendant, whom Chafa's vision helps through Taloa's birth.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Chula's distant ancestor, the first Choctaw. A vision of her helps Chula survive giving birth.

changes.evidence: Chafa is the first Choctaw, an ancestor who lived centuries before Chula; they are a blood tie who never meet. Their only contact is that Chula, in labour with Taloa in the forest, sees visions of Chafa, Lowak and Tuklo. A vision is not an event between people, and no scene or line shows the two know each other.

owner_calls.question: Should Lorelei and Thor stay connected? In Yes Men, Lorelei mocks Sif with the line that Thor is a man who considers her more pet than woman, and Thor never appears. She is an Asgardian prisoner whom Odin had locked up, so it is possible she knew the prince, but nothing on screen shows the two of them dealing with each other. I kept it because it is unclear.
owner_calls.evidence: Lorelei to Sif: "Not Haldorr, not... Thor, a man who considers you more pet than woman." Thor does not appear in the episode.
